activity_summary: Burbage gave the line quieter than you expected and sat on the bare boards. Cowley was afraid of his six lines and held the roll as if it might go off. Burbage said he would play a strong man at being weak, better than his cousin does winning, and Phillips bowed. Nick asked if he means it all, even the parts he is putting on, and you said that is the part. Garnish put nothing in the margin.
